name: Walkers Pure Butter Shortbread Fingers
whyItWorks: Pure Scottish shortbread is made from just 4 ingredients: wheat flour, pure creamery butter, sugar, and salt. It has no chemical leaveners, eggs, or nuts, and literally melts on the tongue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dunk into hot herbal tea. The butter provides clean, dense calories during recovery periods when weight gain is needed.
watchOuts: High in pure butter fat; enjoy 1–2 fingers at a time to avoid fat-induced rapid transit.
